fundamentals.business_description: Royal Bank of Canada provides diversified financial services in Canada and internationally. It operates through Personal & Commercial Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance, Investor & Treasury Services, and Capital Markets segments. RY is Canada's largest bank by market capitalization.

latest_analysis.executive_summary: RBC faces near-term headwinds from compressed net interest margins but maintains its position as Canada's most profitable bank. The stock appears fairly valued at current levels with limited near-term upside relative to TD, which offers a better risk/reward profile.
key_drivers: Net interest margin pressure from rate environment

layer2_context.portfolio_fit_rationale: Held across RRSP and TFSA — consider consolidating into TD for stronger near-term upside while maintaining Financials exposure.
layer2_context.suggested_action: Consider trimming RRSP position and replacing with TD.TO
